name: YMCA Camp Sargent
description_short: A traditional YMCA day camp on Lake Naticook in Merrimack, NH. It offers a general Summer Fun day camp for grades K-8, weekly morning specialty camps for grades K-9, and a Leaders in Training program for grades 9-12.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Lake Naticook. Swimming and boating are part of the daily program, and a Boating Camp for grades 5-9 teaches kayaking, canoeing, paddleboarding, water safety and life jacket use.

warnings: Filled zip 03054: Merrimack has one ZIP code (2020 Census)
This page only shows the 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). Nothing is posted for 2027 yet.

Prices depend on membership: YMCA Family Member, Youth Member or Community Member. Summer Fun costs $270/$300/$410 per week, specialty camps cost $290/$315/$440 per week, the two-week Camp Sargent Players session costs $580/$630/$880, and LIT costs $450/$500/$530 per session. price_per_week and the session prices use the Community (non-member) rate.
The age range of 5-16 comes from the site's navigation blurb. The program sections use grades instead: K-8 for Summer Fun, K-9 for specialty camps and 9-12 for LIT.
Pre/post care costs $65 per child per week. Week 10 also has single-day rates.
The page is the YMCA of Greater Nashua's own page for the camp. The camp also has its own site at campsargent.org.
The page says ACA accredited: check it on acacamps.org and add aca_accredited with aca_source_url
